'''Grasshopper Club Zurich''' ('''GCZ'''), commonly referred to as '''Grasshopper Club''' or simply just '''GC''', is a professional [[sports club|multisports club]] based in [[Zürich|Zurich]], Switzerland. The oldest and best-known department of the club is its [[association football|football]] team. With 27 league titles, the Grasshoppers hold the records for winning the most [[Swiss Super League|national championships]] and the [[Swiss Cup]]s, with 19 trophies in the latter.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=sui/news/newsid=1954325.html |title=Vilotić seals Swiss Cup success for Grasshoppers |publisher=UEFA |date=20 May 2013 |access-date=9 June 2013 |archive-date=11 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180911191448/https://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=sui/news/newsid=1954325.html |url-status=dead}}</ref> The club is the oldest football team in [[Zürich|Zurich]] and maintains a substantial rivalry with [[FC Zürich|FC Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/clubs/rivalries/newsid=1063547/index.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130530143035/http://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/clubs/rivalries/newsid=1063547/index.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=30 May 2013 |title=The great Zurich divide |publisher=FIFA |access-date=9 June 2013}}</ref>

The origin of Grasshoppers name is unknown, although the most common explanation refers to its early players' energetic post-goal celebrations and that their style of play was nimble and energetic.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.gcz.ch/club/geschichte/uebersicht/ |title=GESCHICHTE DES GRASSHOPPER CLUB ZÜRICH |publisher=GCZ |access-date=9 June 2013 |archive-date=7 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160107171144/http://www.gcz.ch/club/geschichte/uebersicht/ |url-status=dead}}</ref>

After a number of appearances in [[UEFA Champions League|European Cups]] and the [[UEFA Champions League]], the Grasshopper Club has become one of Switzerland's most recognizable football clubs. Today, in addition to its main football squad, the club has competitive professional and youth teams in [[Rowing (sport)|rowing]], [[ice hockey]], [[Team handball|handball]], [[tennis|lawn tennis]], [[Real tennis|court tennis]], [[field hockey]], [[curling]], [[basketball]], [[Rugby football|rugby]], [[Squash (sport)|squash]], [[Grasshopper Club Zürich (floorball)|floorball]] and [[beach soccer]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.grasshopper-club.ch/ |title=Sektionen |publisher=GCZ |access-date=9 June 2013 |url-status=live}}</ref>
